title: open-domain structural growth and self-evolution

claim.to_prove: Taiji can grow local structure or memory in response to persistent real-task error, capacity pressure, or recovery deficiency, while retaining old abilities and remaining checkpointable and reversible.
claim.must_not_claim: Growth is not automatic intelligence, unlimited weight addition, neuron-count scaling, or a return to full retraining from scratch.

output.type: versioned structural proposal and lifecycle record
output.update_rule: Only the owning organ proposes content; global governance arbitrates budget, conflict, evidence freshness, and rollback.

trace.provenance: Link every structural change to real task evidence, parent/child lineage, resource ledger, manifest, and checkpoint revision.
trace.determinism: Fixed parent checkpoint, proposal manifest, evidence digest, seed, and budget produce replayable proposal outcomes.

checkpoint.trial_rule: Save a parent/trial checkpoint before structural mutation; no in-memory-only growth qualifies.
checkpoint.continuation: After restore, the next proposal must preserve lineage and budget accounting and must not resurrect a rejected candidate.

red_proof: growth is triggered by scale target only
evidence.holdout: Holdout tasks must use new combinations or future outcomes and must remain read-only; no schema/label leakage into proposal creation.
evidence.lesion: Disable the grown structure, its trace, or the proposal owner; the corresponding transfer/recovery benefit must disappear or the proposal is not causal.
evidence.cross_seed: Admit stable capacity only when gain, retention, and resource trade-offs replicate across seeds and independent task slices.

failure_isolation.candidate_failure: Keep the parent structure active; mark candidate rejected/tombstoned with reason and return unused budget.
failure_isolation.capacity_pressure: Prefer explicit pruning/merge proposal; never silently overwrite a verified structure.
failure_isolation.checkpoint_failure: Abort mutation and reject the candidate; an unpersisted growth is not a model state.

rollback.path: restore parent checkpoint, reverse the resource ledger, mark the child proposal rolled_back, and retain tombstone evidence
rollback.atomicity: Structure, memory/organ state, budget, and lifecycle status commit atomically
rollback.recovery: A rolled-back proposal may be reconsidered only with fresh evidence and a new proposal ID.

boundary: Self-evolution must be evidence-triggered, resource-bounded, and reversible.
The governance layer cannot invent concepts or hard-code biological neuron roles.
Open-domain means broader task evidence and transfer, not an unbounded claim of general intelligence.
replaces: full retraining as the only update path
